sourceClasses.exclusionProof: each user-facing endpoint is the server side of an already-registered capability: abuai-chat/tts/stt/realtime-token back Live+AbuAI; abuai-online backs get_current_info; abuai-news backs AbuNews. health/cron are infra, not user-invokable capabilities.
manifest declares no shortcuts, share_target, or protocol_handlers; start_url is "/" only — it registers no user-entry capability beyond the SPA root already covered.

the SW provides offline caching and the update lifecycle, not a distinct user capability; its only user-visible surface is UpdateToast, an existing UI affordance. (Warm-runtime provenance is separately governed by obligation o-sw.)
